packageRules.description: Security-critical (SAML, crypto, CA, enrollment) and deployed to AWS by a manual procedure: Renovate proposes, a person merges. Nothing automerges here.
crypto11 v1.6.8 renamed its module to github.com/eclipse-keypont/crypto11, so it is not a version bump: moving means changing the import path, deliberately. Hold the old path until then.
openapi-typescript 7.x peers typescript ^5; TypeScript 7 cannot resolve until it supports it.

slackhq/nebula 1.11 changed its public-key PEM banners: with it, internal/configkey rejects config-signing keys and TestFullRotationDrillBothRoots fails (found 2026-09-28 on PR #20). Trust-critical parsing, so the move to 1.11 is a deliberate migration, not a bump. Hold <1.11 until then.
